metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: NOSMOA crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C280 H378 O238 Sm42. From the CIF bond table, Sm1 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm2 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm3 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm4 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm5 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm6 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm7 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm8 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm9 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm10 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm11 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm12 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm13 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm14 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm15 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm16 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm17 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm18 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm19 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm20 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm21 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm1A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm2A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm3A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm4A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm5A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm6A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm7A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm8A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm9A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm10A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm11A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm12A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm13A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm14A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm15A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm16A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm17A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm18A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm19A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm20A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm21A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 70 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.576-3.999 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 90.70-113.10°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C280H378O238Sm42. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 28 OH (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 84 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
